simple.name: Simple
simple.blurb: Fewest decisions; the game runs most things for you.

standard.name: Standard
standard.blurb: Balanced; you choose releases and key deals.

veryComplex.name: Very Complex
veryComplex.blurb: Every rule and decision, as in the original game.

INBOX._note: D3: yearlyCards = max Inbox decision cards per game year (null = no limit). lowPriorityCards = low-priority items only get a card while fewer than this many cards were shown this year. autoDisputes = client delivery disputes are settled automatically (paid rework if affordable, else neutral arbitration).

PRIORITY._note: Inbox item key prefixes. urgent = always shown as a card. low = shown only under lowPriorityCards. Anything else is normal priority.
